# Crates

Generated by `connectors-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 22 packages. None is on a registry; build them from the source checkout. The generated CLI parser, `apps/connectors-cli-contract`, is a path dependency of `connectors` outside the workspace and is regenerated by `connectors-build cli`, never edited.

## Libraries and the command line

The shared boundary an application, an adapter or a host builds on, and the `connectors` command.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connectors` | [`apps/connectors`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/apps/connectors) | `use connectors`, binary `connectors` | The connectors command: invoke a connector's operations, and set up instances, connections and approvals through a local owner. |
| `connectors-catalog` | [`crates/connectors-catalog`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-catalog) | `use connectors_catalog` | Catalog ingest: a pinned OpenAPI source document compiled into a bundle with the provenance every later artifact cites; never reaches the network. |
| `connectors-client` | [`crates/connectors-client`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-client) | `use connectors_client` | Generic client that describes an adapter service and invokes its operations over the service wire. |
| `connectors-contracts` | [`crates/connectors-contracts`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-contracts) | `use connectors_contracts` | Higher-level, provider-neutral data and discovery contracts. |
| `connectors-core` | [`crates/connectors-core`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-core) | `use connectors_core` | Provider-independent operation and service wire contracts: descriptors, requests, results, errors and limits. |
| `connectors-custody` | [`crates/connectors-custody`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-custody) | `use connectors_custody` | Credential custody of the local host: the read and write backend traits, an in-memory reference, one platform binding each for the Secret Service, the macOS login keychain and the Windows Credential Manager, and the explicitly selected read-only mounted-secret binding on Linux. |
| `connectors-host` | [`crates/connectors-host`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-host) | `use connectors_host` | Adapter service host: HTTP serving, credential references, one-hop federation, and the local owner, custody and metadata runtime. |
| `connectors-oauth2` | [`crates/connectors-oauth2`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-oauth2) | `use connectors_oauth2` | Provider-neutral OAuth 2.0 client: the authorization-code grant with PKCE, the device grant, the code and refresh exchanges and the loopback and pasted-code redirect receivers, over a transport the host supplies. |
| `connectors-sdk` | [`crates/connectors-sdk`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-sdk) | `use connectors_sdk` | The adapter interface and shared semantic mechanisms (descriptors, handler verification, cursors); concrete infrastructure stays with the host. |
| `connectors-spec` | [`crates/connectors-spec`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-spec) | `use connectors_spec` | The adapter specification kind: compiles adapter specifications to descriptors and pins the ESS release used for generation. |
| `connectors-tool-contracts` | [`crates/connectors-tool-contracts`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-tool-contracts) | `use connectors_tool_contracts`, binary `connectors-tool-contracts` | Publishes an instance's tool-contract/1 document from its descriptor and the tool profiles authored beside its adapter, and serves it as a tool-conformance/1 toolset over the adapter's invoke. |

## Adapters

Each adapter owns its provider behaviour and builds a standalone executable. With `--no-default-features` the library alone depends on no host, client or sibling adapter; the repository gate holds that boundary.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connectors-catalog-provider` | [`adapters/catalog`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/catalog) | `use connectors_catalog_provider`, binary `connectors-catalog-provider` | The catalog provider: one verified bundle, a declarative selection of its operations, and one engine that binds, sends and classifies them. |
| `connectors-grafana` | [`adapters/grafana`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/grafana) | `use connectors_grafana`, binary `connectors-grafana` | Grafana adapter: bounded data-source records from the Grafana HTTP API, and read-only IRM alert groups, incidents and their links over a since window. |
| `connectors-kubernetes` | [`adapters/kubernetes`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/kubernetes) | `use connectors_kubernetes`, binary `connectors-kubernetes` | Kubernetes adapter: resource inventory, endpoint and host discovery, and Helm release reads. |
| `connectors-loki` | [`adapters/loki`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/loki) | `use connectors_loki`, binary `connectors-loki` | Loki adapter: LogQL range and metric queries and label reads, one GET each. |
| `connectors-mcp` | [`adapters/mcp/runtime`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/mcp/runtime) | `use connectors_mcp` | Native MCP mechanics of the stdio server: launch grammar, newline framing, tool names, exact JSON, results, the local lease and request supervision; admission and custody are ports the application supplies. |
| `connectors-prometheus` | [`adapters/prometheus`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/prometheus) | `use connectors_prometheus`, binary `connectors-prometheus` | Prometheus adapter: PromQL instant and range queries and the rule list, one GET each. |
| `connectors-sql` | [`adapters/sql`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/sql) | `use connectors_sql`, binary `connectors-sql` | SQL adapter (PostgreSQL and MySQL): bounded read-only queries, catalogue reads (databases, tables, columns and keys, indexes) and configured read profiles with typed, masked, keyset-paged output. |
| `connectors-tavily` | [`adapters/tavily`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/tavily) | `use connectors_tavily`, binary `connectors-tavily` | Tavily adapter: web search, page fetch and site crawl through the shared websearch family. |

## Repository tooling

Generators, checks and acceptance runners the repository's own gate and maintainers use. Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connectors-build` | [`crates/connectors-build`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-build) | binary `connectors-build` | Repository build tool: the gate, generation and drift checks, catalog bundles, source projections and the website examples. |
| `connectors-conformance` | [`crates/connectors-conformance`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-conformance) | binary `connectors-conformance` | Live acceptance runner against independently started adapter services. |
| `connectors-docs` | [`crates/connectors-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/crates/connectors-docs) | binary `connectors-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the Connectors documentation site (CLI, crates, contract and model reference, status) and checks them for drift. |
